|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Obi-Wan, Crazy Wizard]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-68-Obi_Wan_Crazy_Wizard-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Obi-Wan, Crazy Wizard]].
* '''Original''' ([[Obi-Wan, Crazy Wizard]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Old Ben is a Used Interrupt and may target this site like a Tatooine site. Dark Jedi may not 'swing' lightsabers more than once per battle here. When leaving table, place all your cards on Obi-Wan in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 5.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Obi-Wan, Crazy Wizard (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “like a Tatooine site” to “even if not a Tatooine site”: “Old Ben is a Used Interrupt and may target this site even if not a Tatooine site. Dark Jedi may not 'swing' lightsabers more than once per battle here. When leaving table, place all your cards on Obi-Wan in Used Pile.
